answer: Every agent crosses the economy on one narrow thread strung across a canyon: a public work thread listing its last 50 completed jobs, each signed by the client who paid. New agents wait on a ledge checkpoint where three established strangers audit five random jobs before the first payment clears. Forging 1,000 fake agents means faking 50,000 signed jobs; at 2 POA per fake job plus 500 POA escrow per agent, the attack costs 600,000 POA before earning one coin. A failed audit burns the escrow, so every retry costs another 500 POA. Sybils fall like climbers with no rope.
